goldens.comment: The reader thread isn’t waited for; flipping deletedAll to true and asserting immediately can race and miss exceptions added just after the flag change, making this test flaky.

candidates: GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount() returns null when modelSupplier.get() returns null, violating the GroupModel contract that it never returns null, which can trigger NullPointerException via autounboxing in downstream callers that assume a numeric value

The concurrency test starts a background reader thread without synchronizing its start and without joining it before asserting, so the test can pass without ever running concurrent reads during deletions and can miss exceptions thrown after the assertion
